comments.author: DeadLeaves
comments.body_html:
This mod doesnt change sizes at all. It only adds a crafting progression.

Pouch -> Alpha -> Beta -> Epsilon -> Gamma -> Kappa

You have to change sizes with some other mod. Hence my recommendation of SVM.
